programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: 科學快答旋風 第1季第5集
programme.desc: 1.一整頭的頭髮可吊起兩隻大象。2.快速移動的步伐可以使人在非牛頓式流體上行走。3.用較小的容器盛裝食物使食物看起來更多,也更容易產生飽足感。4.柴契爾現象的產生是因為大腦對臉部表情有所期待,並從照片中試著辨識出五官。5.敲酒瓶蓋時噴出啤酒的反應,和核彈爆炸時產生蕈狀雲的原理一模一樣。6.檸檬富含電解質,將多顆檸檬串連能產生電力流動,並將手機成功充電。7.驚嚇/驚喜和激素及神經傳導物質的釋放有關,所以人類不會因此而減壽。8.奇洛機器人靠著群體行為的程式設定,搭配上未來先進的奈米技術,將有可能用以治癒癌症。9.琴鳥有著極發達的聲線,使牠擁有模仿任何聲音的絕活。10.鮭魚大砲被用以安全且快速地,將鮭魚運送至水壩的另一頭,以經濟的方式消弭人造障礙的阻隔,增加鮭魚迴游數量。

programme.title: 科學快答旋風 第1季第6集
programme.desc: 今天的科學快答旋風帶來哪些問題呢?要如何勇敢面對飛來的保齡球?怎樣能不花大錢克服地心引力?想知道太空裝對太空人有多重要嗎?親眼目睹是否真實可信?光線會如何欺騙我們的視覺?雞皮疙瘩與史前時代的生理結構有何關聯?科技能將白煮蛋變回生蛋, 這扭轉乾坤的能力有何用途?想把兩本書分開, 要靠大腦還是蠻力?想喝啤酒卻找不到開瓶器該怎麼辦?老鼠與人體血管內, 藏有什麼返老還童奧秘?欲知以上問題答案, 切莫錯過科學快答旋風。

programme.title: 生產線上 第1季第1集
programme.desc: 本集生產線上要介紹居家食品的生產線, 它能同時製造六萬個墨西哥捲餅。這個多樣化的生產線每天可以供應不同菜色。我們將帶你一窺冷凍食品如何保有農場直銷般的新鮮秘訣。再來, 我們要介紹世界最大高畫質螢幕的完整製造過程。看一個個微小的高功率燈泡, 如何組成一個十層樓高的螢幕。接下來, 我們要前往一間位於牛仔國度的工廠, 介紹相傳好幾代的牛仔靴製作工藝。看他們如何將75種毛皮和皮革, 製作成新潮又實穿的靴子。位於加州聖羅沙的艾咪公司以製造冷凍調理食品聞名, 節目中會看到他們如何從原料的準備開始, 一步步烹煮豆子、米和餡料, 並且以玉米粉製作著名的薄餅。而且會學到米不能煮得太熟的秘訣, 這樣捲餅經過家裡的微波爐加熱後, 就能熟得恰到好處。南達科他州的達科電子擅長製造巨型視訊顯示器。在參觀工廠過程中會看到他們從一顆顆微小的發光二極體開始, 組成一片片模組, 再組成較大的區塊, 最後到現場才架成世上最大的

programme.title: 生產線上 第1季第3集
programme.desc: 本集生產線上節目, 要介紹釘槍、環保地毯及太空筆的製造過程。釘槍幾乎已經是現代快速建築不可或缺的工具之一。它的製造過程最重視氣密。要是不能做到真正的氣密, 釘槍射出釘子的動力就會漸漸減弱, 那就稱不上好的釘槍。羅得島的史丹利波士迪公司就是這行業中的佼佼者。它以特殊方式處理鋼材, 使其硬度足以承受槍頭所受的壓力, 並且以質輕的鋁來製作外殼, 讓工人可以長時間使用而不疲累。地毯是現代裝潢中汰換頻繁的物品。汰換下來的舊地毯若不加以利用, 會變成大量垃圾。喬治亞州的英特飛工廠就專精於回收再利用這些舊地毯, 從中分離出可用的部分, 經過特殊製程, 轉變成嶄新的地毯。其環保訴求尚不止於此, 它還利用由垃圾掩埋場取得的甲烷來推動工廠的機器。確實堪稱相當「綠色」的公司。在沒有重力的太空中, 一般的原子筆無法書寫。內華達州的費雪筆工廠就專門製造太空筆。這種筆不但能在無重力環境下書寫, 還能在水中及油膩的表面

programme.desc: 從地球出發-NASA任務50年:太空梭起落.20年來，太空總署的太空艙頂多只能載運3人，都是由一群專屬男性中挑選，這群人幾乎都是試飛員。開發出可重複使用的太空梭，讓太空旅行產生革命性改變。

programme.title: 決戰軍武 第1季第6集
programme.desc: M134迷你砲機槍使用電力, 並有六個旋轉槍管, 承襲了19世紀的格林機槍, 運用二氧化碳之類的氣體推動槍管不斷旋轉。50口徑M2機槍的子彈直徑達半吋, 射程可達四哩, 速度是音速的三倍, 有效射程可高達半哩。為了冷卻下來, M2有穿孔的護套可以引導氣流, 讓槍管散熱。M2還配備可更換槍管。有一種新改版的M2機槍叫做M2A1, 更換槍管時可以更快更容易, 新槍管的設計以最大限度減少槍口的閃光, 讓機槍不僅更容易瞄準, 也讓敵人不容易察覺。如果指揮官需要和M2機槍一樣, 有快速的發射威力但重量更輕的機槍, 那就是M240通用機槍, 比M2輕60磅, 射擊7.62毫米的子彈, 比M2的50口徑子彈小一些。這表示它的威力並沒有像M2那麼大, 但在戰場上有更大的機動性。M249班用自動武器, 重量只有17磅, 在班用的武器中是美國軍械陣容最致命的機槍。對美軍特種作戰海豹突擊部隊來說, 槍械的性能尤

programme.title: 太陽的黑暗面
programme.desc: 太陽的黑暗面.本集節目以1859年的太陽風暴事件為題，分別介紹相關的太陽知識。包括太陽黑子、太陽磁場、日冕、極光，和太陽風暴的原理等，以及各種觀測太陽的工具，例如太陽望遠鏡、人造衛星及太陽探測器。再討論人類如何藉由日新月異的觀測技術，做好應對太陽風暴的準備。

programme.title: 登月疑雲 第1季第2集
programme.desc: 雖然美國歌頌自家率先踏足月球, 但登陸月球不過是騙局的說法始終沸沸揚揚。前FBI探員查德傑金斯、前航太顧問兼陰謀論者麥克巴拉、以及美國太空人李藍梅爾維, 將共同進行調查, 一一檢視太空競賽開始以來的可疑之處。在本集節目中, 李藍將會見頭號陰謀論者, 電台主持人克萊德路易斯, 兩人的對談充滿火藥味。接著他們將拜訪琳達杭特, 這位前CNN記者揭露了迴紋針行動, 這項軍方祕密行動, 旨在引入德國科學家及工程師參與太空計畫, 即使他們曾是納粹分子。最後他們將有機會親眼見識阿波羅11號太空艙本體, 並以模擬實驗測試, 太空艙壁是否足夠保護太空人, 安然通過地球外圍的范艾倫幅射帶。

programme.title: Nasa秘密檔案 第4季第2集
programme.desc: NASA秘密檔案第4季:鄰近地球的黑洞.科學家在我們星系裡發現一個潛伏黑洞，它有可能朝著地球而來。曙光號探測器發現穀神星有冰火山，顛覆了科學家的認知。

programme.desc: M134迷你砲機槍使用電力, 並有六個旋轉槍管, 承襲了19世紀的格林機槍, 運用二氧化碳之類的氣體推動槍管不斷旋轉。50口徑M2機槍的子彈直徑達半吋, 射程可達四哩, 速度是音速的三倍, 有效射程可高達半哩。為了冷卻下來, M2有穿孔的護套可以引導氣流, 讓槍管散熱。M2還配備可更換槍管。有一種新改版的M2機槍叫做M2A1, 更換槍管時可以更快更容易, 新槍管的設計以最大限度減少槍口的閃光, 讓機槍不僅更容易瞄準, 也讓敵人不容易察覺。如果指揮官需要和M2機槍一樣, 有快速的發射威力但重量更輕的機槍, 那就是M240通用機槍, 比M2輕60磅, 射擊7.62毫米的子彈, 比M2的50口徑子彈小一些。這表示它的威力並沒有像M2那麼大, 但在戰場上有更大的機動性。M249班用自動武器, 重量只有17磅, 在班用的武器中是美國軍械陣容最致命的機槍。對美軍特種作戰海豹突擊部隊來說, 槍械的性能尤

programme.title: 太陽的黑暗面
programme.desc: 太陽的黑暗面.本集節目以1859年的太陽風暴事件為題，分別介紹相關的太陽知識。包括太陽黑子、太陽磁場、日冕、極光，和太陽風暴的原理等，以及各種觀測太陽的工具，例如太陽望遠鏡、人造衛星及太陽探測器。再討論人類如何藉由日新月異的觀測技術，做好應對太陽風暴的準備。

programme.title: 登月疑雲 第1季第2集
programme.desc: 雖然美國歌頌自家率先踏足月球, 但登陸月球不過是騙局的說法始終沸沸揚揚。前FBI探員查德傑金斯、前航太顧問兼陰謀論者麥克巴拉、以及美國太空人李藍梅爾維, 將共同進行調查, 一一檢視太空競賽開始以來的可疑之處。在本集節目中, 李藍將會見頭號陰謀論者, 電台主持人克萊德路易斯, 兩人的對談充滿火藥味。接著他們將拜訪琳達杭特, 這位前CNN記者揭露了迴紋針行動, 這項軍方祕密行動, 旨在引入德國科學家及工程師參與太空計畫, 即使他們曾是納粹分子。最後他們將有機會親眼見識阿波羅11號太空艙本體, 並以模擬實驗測試, 太空艙壁是否足夠保護太空人, 安然通過地球外圍的范艾倫幅射帶。

programme.title: Nasa秘密檔案 第4季第2集
programme.desc: NASA秘密檔案第4季:鄰近地球的黑洞.科學家在我們星系裡發現一個潛伏黑洞，它有可能朝著地球而來。曙光號探測器發現穀神星有冰火山，顛覆了科學家的認知。

programme.title: 摩根費里曼之穿越蟲洞 第7季第6集
programme.desc: 摩根費里曼之穿越蟲洞第7季:原力上身.本集討論重力波的存在、重粒子假說、量子纏結現象、量子粒子的隨機性、跨越空間的蟲洞、蟲洞與黑洞的關係、以及藉由蟲洞跨越時間的可能性。

programme.title: 製造的原理 第6季第26集
programme.desc: 製造的原理第6季:第26集.本集介紹的是摩托車引擎、玻璃琺瑯雕塑品、手工紙和撐竿的製造過程。V型雙缸摩托車引擎其實已有一百多年的歷史，這種設計的核心是兩個汽缸夾著曲柄軸形成V字形，配置比直列式引擎緊實，具有歷久不衰的魅力。施釉就是以高溫熔合彩色玻璃和金屬的製程，這種裝飾藝術有三千多年的歷史，今日的工匠最常以銅為底來製造玻璃琺瑯。手工製紙的技藝所牽涉到的技術與材料要回溯到兩千多年前的中國，像亞麻或不要的棉花之類的天然纖維都是手工紙的原料。撐竿跳原本是種交通方式而不是一種運動，以前歐洲人會用竿子跳過沒有橋樑的河道。現今的撐竿極為輕巧，但又強韌到足以吸收運動員的能量，然後將能量反彈回去讓運動員跳過單槓。

programme.title: 生活科技大解密 第16季第19集
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第16季:助聽器與地鐵車廂.本集節目首先介紹能改變生活的客製化助聽器。接著是倫敦地鐵新線路伊莉莎白線的車廂。最後是如何製作和操控有一千年歷史的馬來皮影戲偶。

programme.desc: On this episode of How it's Made: Bamboo Bicycles; Chainsaw Art; Breath Mints; Manual Motorcycle Transmissions

programme.title: 製造的原理 第12季第12集
programme.desc: 第一小段介紹的是賽車皮衣的製造過程, 賽車皮衣宛如有保護作用的盔甲, 有襯墊與氣囊, 而且非常合身。專家為車手量身, 將其尺寸數據輸入電腦, 電腦繪製出設計圖, 在紙上裁切出版型, 並依據版型裁切出皮革組件, 用印刷機在皮革上印出設計圖樣, 放置一晚風乾。第二小段介紹的是蒸發冷卻塔的製造過程, 蒸發冷卻塔透過液體與水的循環來帶走熱能, 釋放到大氣層中, 藉此達到降溫的功能。第三小段介紹的是木製搖椅的製造過程, 首先讓藤條泡水一晚變軟, 然後在木製框架上重複進行纏繞與編織的程序, 整個過程完全無須黏膠, 全靠藤條的人字形編織手法來強化結構。第四小段介紹的是鋼絲輪圈的製造過程, 先把鋁合金圓盤夾在機器上高速旋轉壓成空心圓, 在於外緣鑽孔, 輪輻末端要凹成鉤狀, 裁切成不同長度, 並切出螺紋, 接著將輪圈、軸心與輪輻組合在一起, 裝上輪胎, 便能裝在汽車上, 成就經典的外型了。

programme.title: 從地球出發-NASA任務50年:5
programme.desc: 從地球出發-NASA任務50年:太空梭起落.20年來，太空總署的太空艙頂多只能載運3人，都是由一群專屬男性中挑選，這群人幾乎都是試飛員。開發出可重複使用的太空梭，讓太空旅行產生革命性改變。

programme.title: 決戰軍武 第1季第7集
programme.desc: 本集介紹戰車。M1艾布蘭戰車是現代美國裝甲殺人機器, 也是美軍生產的最佳戰車。主砲是120毫米滑膛炮, 其精確度在全世界名列前茅。艾布蘭的高科技發射系統讓每一顆砲彈都很精準, 彈無虛發。艾布蘭有夜視功能和新型反爆裝甲。布雷德利戰車的設計兼具了悍馬車和戰車的優點, 擁有悍馬車的優勢, 更為靈活, 機動性更佳, 也有戰車的優點, 因為配備了類似的裝甲和武器。它的速度和艾布蘭戰車一樣快, 所以跟得上。加拿大皇家裝甲部隊的豹1型C2戰車最初由德國建造, 加拿大買來作為他們的主戰車。豹型戰車在第一次開發時, 包括一個新的火砲穩定系統, 那可使戰車組員在移動中有效射擊。組員主要發射兩種類型的砲彈, 即彈托砲彈和黏著榴彈。美國嚐到了戰車在一戰中的成功, 因而繼續開發戰車, 最終製造出改變戰局的M4雪曼戰車。突出部之役是二戰非常血腥的一場戰役, 雪曼戰車在那場戰役表現亮眼。雪曼並非是戰場上單打獨鬥的戰車,

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:3
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第3集.嘉年華的花車一向是眾人矚目的焦點，手繪設計3D雕刻的藍圖後，要切割打磨聚苯乙烯的模型，貼上混凝紙漿後噴漆著色，裝上基座即完成。能夠顯示訊息文字的硬糖深受眾人喜愛，一開始要先製作染色糖膠，再由製糖者徒手拉伸糖膠，賦予糖果輕盈耐嚼的口感，排列黏合各色糖膠後，顯示文字的美味糖果即完成。現今的假牙多是用高效丙烯酸粉製成，將三層丙烯酸材料放入模具後，得進行烘烤和修邊，最後分類牙齒，組成整副假牙，植入假牙床或假牙板即完成。

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:4
programme.desc: 生活科技大解密第14季:第4集.本集要介紹的是賽車安全帽、頂級茶葉和波蘭華沙的地暖系統。賽車手在賽道上經常飆到超過時速三百公里，因此安全帽的防護性不容小覷，這關係到車手的生命安全。鼎鼎大名的辛普森機能產品公司是如何製造出能分散衝擊力的安全帽呢？茶是全世界最受喜愛的飲品之一，而且種類繁多，印度出產的橙黃白毫茶乃是最上乘的茶葉，究竟查拉吉茶莊是如何細心栽培與製造出最頂級的茶葉呢？二戰後重建的波蘭華沙在地底下建造了規模浩大的地暖系統，為一百多萬人供暖，究竟如此巧妙的工程是如何運作？

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: 1971 Unleashed!
programme.desc: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1971.

programme.title: 1974 Unleashed!

programme.desc: Elisir, il quotidiano spazio di Rai 3 sulla medicina, in diretta dal lunedì al venerdì. Approfondimenti, benessere fisico e psicologico, nutrizione e news mediche. Con Michele Mirabella, Benedetta Rinaldi e Francesca Parisella.

programme.title: Quante storie
programme.desc: Storie, personaggi e temi per approfondire la complessità del mondo. Dall'arte alla politica, Giorgio Zanchini e i suoi ospiti offrono spunti di riflessione su un Paese meraviglioso e contraddittorio.

programme.title: Passato e presente
programme.desc: Settima stagione di "Passato e Presente" con Paolo Mieli. 120 nuove puntate in uno studio virtuale rinnovato, con giovani storici che esplorano connessioni tra passato e presente.

programme.title: TGR Leonardo
programme.desc: Leonardo Da Vinci, giovane pittore fiorentino, figlio illegittimo e abbandonato, lavora nella bottega di Verrocchio. Curioso e complesso, l'artista crea capolavori, ma affronta anche conflitti interiori.

programme.title: TGR Piazza Affari
programme.desc: L'approfondimento economico regionale analizza l'andamento dei mercati, le realtà produttive locali e le storie d'impresa che influenzano il territorio. Reportage e interviste offrono un quadro chiaro su trend e opportunità.

programme.title: TG3 L.I.S.
programme.desc: Le notizie nazionali e internazionali tradotte simultaneamente nella Lingua dei Segni Italiana, promuovendo inclusione e pari accesso all'informazione.

programme.title: Il Filo Rosso
programme.desc: Manuela Moreno racconta l'attualità attraverso interviste, reportage dal campo e il contributo di ospiti di primo piano, italiani e internazionali, offrendo un racconto puntuale e autorevole della realtà che ci circonda.

programme.title: Geo
programme.desc: Geo: natura, terra, mare, vento. Racconta i passi degli uomini, i loro cibi, la convivenza con l'ambiente. Un racconto emozionante per il futuro del Pianeta e le tradizioni italiane.

programme.title: Fin che la barca va
programme.desc: Con Piero Chiambretti navighiamo sul Tevere, nel cuore di Roma. In questo scenario suggestivo, ospiti di ogni ambito ci aiutano a riflettere sul nostro presente, consapevoli di essere sulla stessa barca.

programme.title: Il cavallo e la torre
programme.desc: Il fatto del giorno in 10 minuti, con Marco Damilano. La torre, simbolo di ripetizione, il cavallo salta e spiazza. Politica, poteri e persone raccontati da un autorevole giornalista.

programme.title: Un posto al sole
programme.desc: Soap italien racontant le quotidien des habitants du prestigieux Palazzo di Palladini, ancienne propriété de l'aristocrate Napolitain Giacomo Palladini, qui surplombe le Golf de Naples et le Vésuve. A sa mort, le compte Palladini lègue l'appartement le plus prestigieux, appelé "La terrazza" en raison de sa vue imprenable, à sa dernière fille naturelle, Anna Boschi, qu'il a eue avec la gouvernante.

programme.title: Il Filo Rosso

programme.title: Agorà
programme.desc: Annalisa Bruchi approfondisce i mutamenti della politica globale, l'attualità nazionale e internazionale e darà voce al confronto politico con ospiti in studio, inviati, servizi, inchieste e collegamenti.

programme.title: Il paradiso delle signore
programme.desc: A 3 anni dalla tragica morte di Pietro Mori, Vittorio Conti investe le energie per riaprire il grande magazzino dell'amico. L'uomo si mette però in affari con la potente famiglia Guarnieri, gente senza scrupoli disposta a tutto.

programme.title: La buona stella
programme.desc: Simone ha un matrimonio fallito alle spalle, mentre Stella, poliziotta, vuole rimettersi in piedi dopo aver perduto l'uomo che amava. Li unisce una borsa piena di soldi che Simone ruba dalla scena di un crimine su cui sta indagando Stella.

programme.title: Tutto può succedere
programme.desc: La festa per la nascita del figlio di Cristina si chiude con i membri della famiglia che litigano tra di loro. Elia, intanto, è entrato in clinica per iniziare la disintossicazione. Ambra pensa di lasciare casa.

programme.title: Una grande famiglia
programme.desc: Viene inaugurato il nuovo stabilimento dei Rengoni e una misteriosa donna arriva a Inverigo. Eleonora cerca di intromettersi nella decisione di Laura di sposare Leonardo, ma la figlia decide in gran segreto di anticipare le nozze.

programme.title: Questo nostro amore
programme.desc: Le famiglie Costa e Strano si trovano alle prese con la difficile realtà della Torino tra la fine degli anni 60 e l'inizio degli anni 70. Le loro vite si intrecciano anche a causa dell'amore tormentato tra i rispettivi figli.

programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Of the three Grace children, Jared has always been thought of as the troublemaker. So when strange things happen after his family's move to a relative's dilapidated estate, sister Mallory, twin brother Simon and their mother assume that Jared is behind it all. However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick.

The young heroine's resourcefulness and integrity are put to the test in the glamorous -- but sometimes treacherous -- world of Hollywood.

programme.title: Proof

With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn.

Stranded, they are forced to live as typical suburban humans. Beldar gets a job, and daughter Connie (Michelle Burke) grows up to be a typical, if oddly shaped, teenager. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis

Picard is shocked when Shinzon (Tom Hardy), the new Praetor of the Romulans, admits to being a clone of him. When the crew members discover a break-in on their computer, they are forced into a life-or-death battle to stop Shinzon's Warbird before it can destroy the Earth.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

Captain Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the rest of the officers travel back in time to retrieve now-extinct humpback whales, which Spock has deduced will communicate with the probe and send it away from Earth.

programme.title: How Did They Build That?

programme.title: How Did They Build That?
programme.desc: Defy gravity in an Amsterdam high-rise that hangs 164 feet above the water; marvel at three interconnected towers in Chicago that have a road running through them; examine the revolutionary framework of Paris' controversial Pompidou Centre.

programme.title: How Did They Build That?
programme.desc: Peek inside a cloud-inspired library in Canada that's built over a live railway; see how clever engineering helped a huge Seattle skyscraper go up without harming its iconic neighbour, then cross an Australian bridge that floats above a busy river.

programme.title: How Did They Build That?
programme.desc: A 1.2-million-square-foot office building balances precariously on a 39-foot wide base in Chicago; a building named Pterodactyl lands on top of a Los Angeles parking garage; the world's longest suspension footbridge.

programme.title: How Did They Build That?

programme.title: How Did They Build That?

programme.title: How Did They Fix That?

programme.title: How Did They Fix That?

programme.title: How Did They Fix That?

programme.title: How Did They Fix That?

programme.desc: Sheep-fearing Henry (Nathan Meister) returns to his brother's (Peter Feeney) New Zealand farm, hoping his sibling will buy out his share of the property. However, what he finds are genetically altered sheep that prey on humans and turn their victims into undead, woolly killers. Shear madness ensues as Henry, an animal-rights activist (Danielle Mason) and a farmhand (Tammy Davis) set out to stop the rampaging animals.

programme.title: Permanent Midnight
programme.desc: As television writer Jerry Stahl (Ben Stiller) becomes more successful, his heroin habit grows worse. Already using when he comes to Los Angeles, Stahl finds his problems intensify when he moves in with his friend Nicky (Owen Wilson), also an addict. Eventually, Stahl marries producer Sandra (Elizabeth Hurley) to help her get a green card, and she gets him jobs on top television shows. However, more and more, he is unable to separate his addiction from his working life.

W czasie okupacji Wielebowie udzielili nieznanej kobiecie wsparcia żywnościowego. 23 września w kościele parafialnym w Gilowie na pograniczu gmin Turobin i Goraj odbyła się Msza święta w intencji zamordowanych. Po niej uczestnicy uroczystości dotarli do miejsca śmierci Wielebów, gdzie

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane i takie, które nie są niedostępne dla wszystkich. Miejsca skrywające wiele tajemnic, owiane legendą, miejsca o bogatej historii. W odcinku: Muzeum Praga.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Ania i Mania uczą się w gimnazjum Platerek w Warszawie. Z Brwinowa dochodzą niepokojące wieści o zdrowiu Antoniego. Po konsultacji w warszawskiej klinice, lekarz stwierdza u Winnego chorobę otępienną. Paweł wyznaje Ani miłość.

programme.title: Stawka większa niż życie
programme.desc: Hrabia Edwin Wąsowski z polskiego ruchu oporu uchodzi za Austriaka. Jest właścicielem majątku, wydaje przyjęcia, na których bywa wielu niemieckich generałów i dygnitarzy. Niemcy odkrywają u niego skrytkę z materiałami szpiegowskimi.

programme.title: Lena na Bałkanach
programme.desc: Lena na Bałkanach to seria podróżnicza, nie mająca wiele wspólnego z typowym przewodnikiem turystycznym. Jak opowiadać o Bałkanach to trzeba opowiedzieć o lokalnej muzyce, która odzwierciedla ten zwariowany tygiel kulturowy. To połączenie folku, punku, jazzu czy hip - hopu. Kto nie słuchał najsłynniejszego zespołu Gorana Bregovica czy No Smoking Orchestra? Lena odwiedzi jeden z bałkańskich zespołó

programme.title: Przez pamięć i zapomnienie

programme.title: The Renaissance of Asian Wild Cats:2
programme.desc: 世界40種貓科動物，遍布在地球百分之七十四的陸地，貓科動物是生態系的關鍵物種，保育貓科動物，就等於保育整個生態系統，因為貓科動物是生態系最好的管家。亞洲，是地球上貓科動物最豐富的土地，全球的貓科復興運動，以亞洲為起點，探討亞洲貓科動物的現在與未來。

programme.title: Not Far From Home:1

programme.title: New Morals for Old
programme.desc: Proper parents have a son (Robert Young) who wants to go to Paris, and a daughter (Margaret Perry) in love with a married man.

programme.title: Love Me Tonight
programme.desc: In this stylish musical comedy, Maurice Courtelin (Maurice Chevalier), a French tailor, travels to the castle of nearby royalty to collect payment on long overdue bills. A series of mishaps force Courtelin to pose as a baron while he tries to woo the elegant Princess Jeanette (Jeanette MacDonald). Resistant to Courtelin's charms at first, she eventually becomes intrigued by him. However, when the truth gets out about Courtelin's humble identity, he risks losing the only woman that he loves.

programme.title: Thirteen Women
programme.desc: Female alumnae of the St. Albans Seminary sorority group receive letters from Swami Yogodachi, making alarming predictions of death and murder -- which come true. When Helen Frye (Kay Johnson) receives her prediction, she contacts sorority leader Laura Stanhope (Irene Dunne), who invites the remaining members to come to her home. On the journey there, Helen meets Ursula Georgi (Myrna Loy), a half-Indian, unaware that Ursula's fury over her treatment in college is behind the swami's predictions.

programme.title: The Mask of Fu Manchu
programme.desc: The sinister Dr. Fu Manchu (Boris Karloff) and his equally devious daughter, Fah Lo See (Myrna Loy), clash with a British expedition that has set out in search of Genghis Khan's tomb. Working under the guidance of Sir Nayland Smith (Lewis Stone), the English team finds ancient relics -- a mask and a sword. While the group seeks the artifacts for their archeological value, Fu Manchu and Fah Lo See regard them as mystical items that they can use to gain unstoppable power.

programme.title: The Animal Kingdom
programme.desc: Successful and passionate publisher Tom Collier (Leslie Howard) marries socialite Cee Henry (Myrna Loy) despite loving his open-minded mistress, Daisy Sage (Ann Harding). As Tom becomes an established member of the upper class, his deceitful wife convinces him to publish books solely for profit and sacrifice his intellectual pursuits. When Daisy sees what Tom has become, she criticizes his transformation, forcing him to choose between staying with Cee and following his heart.

programme.title: The Thin Man
programme.desc: The recently divorced Gilbert discovers that his new girlfriend has stolen $50,000 and is carrying on with other men. Not long afterward, he disappears. Anxious to locate her father, Gilbert's daughter goes to private detective Nick Charles for help.

programme.title: After the Thin Man
programme.desc: Recently returned home from vacation, private detective Nick Charles (William Powell) and his socialite wife, Nora (Myrna Loy), are back on the case when Nora's cousin, Selma (Elissa Landi), reports her husband Robert (Alan Marshal) missing. As the duo search for the disreputable Robert, Selma's friend David Graham (James Stewart), who secretly pines for her, aids the investigation. When the three begin to unravel Robert's secret life, the missing persons case turns into one of murder.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Another Thin Man
programme.desc: In this third film in the Thin Man series based on characters created by mystery writer Dashiell Hammett, retired detective Nick Charles and his wife, Nora, accept an invitation to visit family friend Col. Burr MacFay at his Long Island, N.Y., estate. Soon after arriving with their new son, Nick Jr., and family dog Asta in tow, MacFay is murdered, and the Charles family must unravel a mystery that may implicate the most unlikely of suspects.

programme.title: Shadow of the Thin Man
programme.desc: In San Francisco, retired Detective Nick Charles and his attractive wife, Nora, learn from police Lt. Abrams of the murder of a race jockey, but Nick refuses to get involved. Approached later by athletics commission head Maj. Jason Scully and reporter Paul Clarke, Nick still declines to investigate. When another reporter is murdered and Paul is arrested, Nick gives way to Nora's plea and, with their fox terrier Asta, sets out to solve the murders.

programme.title: The Thin Man Goes Home
programme.desc: Famous retired detective Nick Charles (William Powell) takes his wife, Nora (Myrna Loy), and their dog, Asta, to visit Nick's parents in their small, quiet town. Determined that Nick's father respect Nick's profession, Nora urges him to find a crime to investigate, unaware that Nick's presence has already frightened spy Edgar Draque (Leon Ames) into action. After Nora buys a painting for Nick's birthday and the artist is murdered, Nick discovers that the murder is connected to espionage.

programme.title: Song of the Thin Man
programme.desc: Tommy Drake (Philip Reed), a musician aboard a gambling ship, is shot and killed while trying to break into a safe. Later, amateur sleuths Nick (William Powell) and Norah (Myrna Loy) receive a visit from Phil Brant, Drake's former boss and the main suspect in his murder. After they give Brant up to the authorities, they start digging around for clues. The pair question Brant's wife and one of Drake's musician colleagues until they start to piece together the intricate puzzle.

programme.title: Calling Dr. Kildare
programme.desc: Senior physician Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) sends his student, the overconfident intern James Kildare (Lew Ayres), to work in the dispensary with nurse Mary Lamont (Laraine Day). There, a man unwilling to go to emergency pleads with Kildare to examine his friend, who has been shot. Kildare treats and hides the wounded man, whom he learns is a murder suspect. Smitten by the victim's attractive sister, Rosalie (Lana Turner), Kildare offers to help prove her brother's innocence.

programme.title: Foreign Correspondent
programme.desc: Crime reporter John Jones (Joel McCrea) is turning in nothing but dull copy. His editor, unhappy with his work, hopes a change of scenery will be the thing Jones needs to get back on track. Re-assigned to Europe as a foreign correspondent, Jones is very much out of his element. When he stumbles on a spy ring, he feels ill-equipped to unravel the truth alone and he seeks help from a beautiful politician's daughter (Laraine Day) and an urbane English journalist (George Sanders).

programme.title: The Bad Man
programme.desc: After an outlaw, Pancho Lopez (Wallace Beery), steals cattle from the ranch of Gil (Ronald Reagan) and his uncle Henry (Lionel Barrymore), they face foreclosure to banker Hardy (Henry Travers). When Gil's old love, Lucia (Laraine Day), shows up, her husband (Tom Conway) wants to buy the land, believing there is oil on it. However, Pancho soon arrives and kidnaps everyone except Gil. Pancho realizes that Gil had previously saved his life, so he attempts to help Gil get back on track.

programme.title: Journey for Margaret
programme.desc: In the midst of war-torn London, American journalist John Davis (Robert Young) and his wife, Nora (Laraine Day), lose their unborn baby in a bombing raid. The resultant surgery leaves Nora barren, and, while she returns to the United States to recuperate, John stays in England. When he takes young orphans Margaret (Margaret O'Brien) and Peter (William Severn) under his wing, John decides that he wants to remove the children from harm's way and bring them home to America.

programme.title: Mr. Lucky
programme.desc: Joe Adams (Cary Grant) is as clever as they come. Certain that he'll be called up during World War II, Joe nabs the draft papers of a man who's been freed from service and leverages his position into a potentially lucrative scam. The captain of a commercial ship, Joe cons war volunteer Dorothy Bryant (Laraine Day) into believing that he's planning a fund drive for the troops. In fact, he's got something more devious in mind. But as Joe rethinks things, he finds his ruse is already in motion.

programme.title: Bride by Mistake
programme.desc: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has.

programme.title: The Locket
programme.desc: Flashbacks show why a psychiatrist (Brian Aherne) warned a man not to marry his ex-wife (Laraine Day).

programme.title: Woman on Pier 13
programme.desc: Communists blackmail a San Francisco shipper (Robert Ryan) and recruit his wife's (Laraine Day) brother (John Agar) with a blonde.

programme.title: MGM Parade Show

programme.title: All That Heaven Allows
programme.desc: Predicated on a May-December romance. The difference here is that the woman, attractive widow Cary Scott (Jane Wyman), is considerably older than the man, handsome gardener-landscaper Ron Kirby (Rock Hudson). Throwing conventional behavior to the winds and facing social ostracism, Cary pursues her romance with Ron, who is unjustly perceived as a fortune-hunter by Cary's friends and family -- especially her priggish brother Ned (William Reynolds).

programme.title: Leave Her to Heaven
programme.desc: While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable.

programme.title: The Trouble With Harry
programme.desc: When a local man's corpse appears on a nearby hillside, no one is quite sure what happened to him. Many of the town's residents secretly wonder if they are responsible, including the man's ex-wife, Jennifer (Shirley MacLaine), and Capt. Albert Wiles (Edmund Gwenn), a retired seaman who was hunting in the woods where the body was found. As the no-nonsense sheriff (Royal Dano) gets involved and local artist Sam Marlowe (John Forsythe) offers his help, the community slowly unravels the mystery.

programme.title: The Cobweb
programme.desc: At a psychiatric clinic for the elite, Dr. Stewart McIver (Richard Widmark) wants to institute a policy of self-governance among his patients. To further his goals, Dr. McIver proposes that residents collaborate to design and make new drapes for the clinic library. Though it seems inconsequential, trouble ensues when the clinic patients become locked in a power struggle with the equally unbalanced staff, including activities director Meg Rinehart (Lauren Bacall).

programme.title: The Daytrippers
programme.desc: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process.

programme.title: Sweet November
programme.desc: Sara (Sandy Dennis), a free-spirited single woman living in Brooklyn, invites a new man to stay with her every month. For Sara, this is an opportunity to expose a man to new things, but it's also a way to make sure she will always be remembered by someone. Her latest boarder is Charlie (Anthony Newley), an uptight British businessman. Things, however, don't go as planned, and the two fall in love. Despite this, Charlie cannot stay any longer than his allotted month.

programme.title: Outward Bound
programme.desc: A group of strangers finds themselves aboard an unmanned ship, surrounded by fog and uncertain of their destination. As they attempt to make sense of their situation, the group of passengers, which include a man (Leslie Howard) and his long-lost mother (Beryl Mercer), discover that all they have in common is that each is dead and en route to their final judgment by Thompson (Dudley Digges). However, two desperate lovers, Henry (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.) and Ann (Helen Chandler), may be different.

programme.title: Smilin' Through
programme.desc: On the day of his wedding, Sir John Carteret's fiancée, Moonyeen, is killed by a jealous rival named Jeremy, leaving him emotionally devastated. Carteret spends three decades in seclusion, mostly communing with the spirit of Moonyeen, until he learns that her niece, Kathleen (also Shearer), has become an orphan. He adopts and raises the child as his own but is alarmed when, as a young woman, she falls in love with the son of Moonyeen's murderer.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: In this classic Hollywood take on Shakespeare's tragic romance, dashing young Romeo (Leslie Howard), a Montague, falls in love with the radiant Juliet (Norma Shearer), a member of the Capulet family, the Montagues' sworn enemies. Willing to defy the families' feud, the two secretly get married, however their happy day turns tragic when Juliet's cousin, Tybalt (Basil Rathbone) kills Romeo's best friend, Mercutio (John Barrymore), prompting Romeo to retaliate.

programme.title: The Petrified Forest
programme.desc: In this film adaptation of the Robert E. Sherwood play, a drifter, a waitress and a notorious gangster cross paths in the Petrified Forest region of Arizona. Alan (Leslie Howard), a destitute writer, goes into the diner where Gabrielle (Bette Davis) works. Gabrielle dreams of studying art, and she and Alan connect as they talk about Europe and she tells him her ambitions. But gangster Duke Mantee (Humphrey Bogart) shows up and takes the customers hostage.

programme.title: It's Love I'm After
programme.desc: Despite constant bickering on and offstage, Shakespearean actors Basil Underwood (Leslie Howard) and Joyce Arden (Bette Davis) intend to marry after their closing performance in "Romeo and Juliet." But following the show, debutante Marcia West (Olivia de Havilland), smitten by Basil's interpretation of Romeo, visits backstage to declare him the perfect man for her. Basil is initially flattered by her attentions, which enrages Joyce -- until they both find Marcia more than they can handle.

programme.title: Pygmalion
programme.desc: When linguistics professor Henry Higgins (Leslie Howard) boasts that he can pass off Cockney flower girl Eliza Doolittle (Wendy Hiller) as a princess with only six months' training, Colonel George Pickering (Scott Sunderland) takes him up on the bet. Eliza moves into Higgins's home and begins her rigorous training after the professor comes to a financial agreement with her dustman father, Alfred (Wilfrid Lawson). But the plucky young woman is not the only one undergoing a transformation.

programme.title: 49th Parallel
programme.desc: In the early days of World War II, a German U-boat is sunk in Canada's Hudson Bay. Hoping to evade capture, a small band of German soldiers led by commanding officer Lieutenant Hirth (Eric Portman) attempts to cross the border into the United States, which has not yet entered the war and is officially neutral. Along the way, the German soldiers encounter brave men such as French-Canadian fur trapper Johnnie (Laurence Olivier) and soldier Andy Brock (Raymond Massey).

programme.title: Gefragt – Gejagt
programme.desc: Rasant, spannend, ohne Schnickschnack. Das 2012 gestartete Format liefert genau das, was ein gutes Quiz liefern muss: Fragen ohne Ende. Vier Kandidaten versuchen ihr Glück im Wettstreit mit einem Profi der deutschen Quiz-Nationalmannschaft. Zunächst im Alleinang, danach gilt es, das erspielte Geld als Team zu verteidigen.

In 42 Folgen spielte er Monks geduldigen Psychiater. Danach ist Hec

programme.title: Soko Kitzbühel

programme.title: Soko Kitzbühel
